name: cloudonym
description: Cloud resource names from five context values, checked by the Cloudonym API. Asks questions on a terminal; flags and JSON for scripts.

scripts.prepack: node -e "for (const f of ['LICENSE', 'NOTICE']) require('node:fs').copyFileSync('../' + f, f)"
scripts.postpack: node -e "for (const f of ['LICENSE', 'NOTICE']) require('node:fs').rmSync(f, { force: true })"
